personality_one_liner: A high-contrast, fast-scanning operational surface for cold storage environments, where utility and readability are the only things that matter.

spacing.rule: Use tight, operational spacing to maximize data density while keeping touch targets large enough for gloved interaction (min 56pt height).

do's: Keep surfaces solid for maximum contrast and legibility in variable lighting.
dont's: Do not use blur or glassmorphism. This is a fast-response utility app.

screens.name: Search (Cerca)
screens.purpose: Primary scanner/search screen to instantly look up a pallet by its position number.

states.loading: Spinner in the center of the results area.
states.empty: Empty state illustration with text 'Nessuna pedana trovata' (No pallet found).
states.error: Red error text 'Errore di ricerca' with retry button.

screens.layout: Top half is a massive, high-contrast search input focused by default for barcode scanner or keyboard input. The input should use oversized condensed typography. Below the input, display instant search results as stacked, high-contrast cards. If a single exact match is found, auto-navigate to the detail screen.

screens.name: Position Detail (Dettaglio Pedana)
screens.purpose: Displays critical pallet routing information clearly for a worker in motion.

states.error: Red error text with back button.

screens.layout: Destination name (e.g. 'Thekla Göpel GmbH') dominates the top in oversized condensed font. Below it, a segmented grid of metrics: Supplier, Order Number, Product, Colli, Temperature (2-6°C). Use strong divider lines between data points. Primary sticky CTA at bottom: 'Chiudi' or 'Conferma'.

screens.name: Orders List (Ordini)
screens.purpose: Shows all imported transport orders and their associated positions.

states.empty: Empty box illustration with text 'Nessun ordine presente' (No orders present).

screens.layout: List items grouped by Transport Order. Each header shows the order number (e.g. '25023467'). Tapping an order expands to show its positions. Swipe-to-delete on orders/positions. High-contrast labels for position codes.

screens.name: Data Entry (Aggiungi)
screens.purpose: Allows importing orders via PDF or entering positions manually.

states.loading: Processing AI parsing with progress indicator.

screens.layout: Two massive touch-friendly blocks. Block 1: 'Importa da PDF' (triggers file picker and Gemini AI parse). Block 2: 'Aggiungi Manualmente' (opens a strict, single-column form with large inputs for Position, Destination, Supplier, Product, Colli). Sticky submit button at the bottom.

warehouse_hero_bg.alt: Dark warehouse aisle with wrapped pallets

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Personality 7 (Dark-First Utility DARK). Stick strictly to the provided color palette. Do NOT use any blue, purple, or indigo.
The app is for warehouse workers in a cold environment. Touch targets MUST be massive (min 56pt, preferably 64pt for key actions) to accommodate gloved interaction.
Typography: Use 'Barlow Condensed' for metrics, destinations, and position codes (oversized, e.g., 32pt - 48pt). Use 'IBM Plex Sans' for readable labels.
Layout: Focus on high contrast and instant scanability. Use sharp edges (sm radius) and thick dividers rather than soft shadows or blur.
For the suppliers (Orchidea frutta, Antolini, etc.), use the fallback initials avatar in a brandTertiary square (e.g., 'OF', 'AN', 'MG') since specific logos were not found.
All UI strings should ideally be in Italian as requested by the user.
Always apply a top-to-bottom dark gradient scrim over the warehouse_hero_bg if text is overlaid on it.
